description: This file contains unit tests for the LuhnIdentifierValidator class, specifically testing the retrieval and validation of identifiers with check digits, including both valid and invalid cases.

classes.name: LuhnIdentifierValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for LuhnIdentifierValidator, verifying correct behavior of getValidIdentifier() and isValid() methods with various identifier inputs.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldGetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that the getValidIdentifier method returns correctly formatted identifiers with check digits.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldFailWithInvalidIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures that invalid identifiers trigger UnallowedIdentifierException when calling getValidIdentifier.

methods.name: shouldValidate
methods.description: Tests the isValid method with various allowed, disallowed, and malformed identifiers, including check digit validation.
